1. (Currently Amended) A composite stiffener, comprising: first, second and third members formed from laminated composite tape, the first and second members defining a web and flange member being joined to the flanges and extending generally transverse to the web, the first, second and third composite members intersecting to form a void; a filler disposed in and substantially filling the void; __at least one layer of composite fabric on each of the members in the area of the filler, wherein the composite fabric layer is applied as a post-cure surface treatment after initial lamination of the composite tape members__; and, a layer of adhesive surrounding the filler and joining the filler to the composite fabric.

2. (Currently Amended) The composite stiffener of claim 1, wherein the first and second members include radius areas between the web and each of the flanges, and the fabric layer covers the radius areas __and is applied as a post-cure surface treatment__.

3. (Original) [Claim text not provided in original application record]

4. (Original) The composite stiffener of claim 1, wherein the at least one layer of composite fabric includes graphite fibers held in an epoxy matrix.

5. (Currently Amended) The composite stiffener of claim 1, wherein the layer of adhesive and the at least one layer of composite fabric extend beyond the radius areas __and the adhesive is a structural adhesive applied as a post-cure bonding layer__.

6. (Currently Amended) The composite stiffener of claim 1, wherein the at least one layer of composite fabric of the composite members are offset relative to each other __and are applied to the surface of the composite members after the laminated composite tape plies are formed__.

7. (Currently Amended) A composite stiffener, comprising: a pair of composite channels joined together, each of the channels including a web, flanges extending from the web, and radius areas between the web and each of the flanges; a base extending transverse to the web and joined to each of the flanges, the radius areas of the channels and the base forming at least one radius filler zone; a reinforcing member filling the radius filler zone; a layer of composite fabric covering the radius areas of the channels and the base, __wherein the composite fabric is applied as a post-cure surface treatment to the channels and base__; and, a layer of adhesive surrounding the filler and joining the filler to the composite fabric layer.

12. (Currently Amended) The composite stiffener of claim 7, wherein the composite fabric layer includes three composite patches respectively on each of the channels and the base, __wherein the patches are applied as post-cure surface treatments__.

13. (Currently Amended) The composite stiffener of claim 7, wherein the layer of adhesive includes a sheet of structural adhesive wrapped around the filler __and applied as a post-cure bonding layer__.

14. (Original) [Claim text not provided in original application record]

15. (Currently Amended) The composite stiffener of claim 7, the channels are __formed from laminated composite tape plies and the composite fabric is applied as a post-cure surface treatment__.

25. (Currently Amended) A composite stiffener for aircraft applications, comprising: an I-section structure formed of laminated composite tape with a web and flanges on each end of the web, the structure including a cap and base including radius areas between the web and the flanges and cap being joined to the first set of the flanges and the base being joined to the second set of flanges, the cap and the base each intersecting the web in the radius areas to define a radius filler zone; __a layer of composite fabric covering the radius areas and applied as a post-cure surface treatment to the I-section structure defining the radius filler zone__; a reinforcing filler in the radius filler zone; and __a layer of structural adhesive applied as a post-cure bonding layer joining the filler to the composite fabric in the radius filler zone__.
